unicode_create_reuse.details: Creates nested Chinese Markdown and Greek code-note members plus an outside-workspace Chinese Markdown extra, checks member names, requires a UTF-8 flag on the archive, repeats create for deterministic reuse, and checks restored selected bytes and extra bytes in fixed mode.

ascii_control.details: Creates, verifies and restores an ASCII member, checks exact restored bytes, and requires zero flags for every listed archive member.

flag_and_name_refusals.details: Exercises local-only, central-only and both-header mutations for encryption, data-descriptor and unknown bits, then missing/noncanonical/mismatched UTF-8 flags and malformed UTF-8 names. Each mutation is required to return LIGHT_BACKUP_INVALID from verify_backup.

unicode_restore_refusal_invariant.details: The legacy R7 path checks Unicode restore refusal and destination absence. The fixed path checks successful restore. The mutated flag/name archives are verified only; the harness does not call restore_backup for each mutation or compare input bytes after refusal.

synthetic_boundary.details: The harness creates a fresh temporary .work tree under /private/tmp and declares real_corpus_read=false; no product source or Vault mutation is performed by the script.

static_findings.summary: The harness imports light_backup from caller-controlled PYTHONPATH and reports only pythonpath_source_is_external=true. It does not record backup.__file__, the resolved module SHA-256, or the expected stopped R8 source root/candidate hash.
static_findings.impact: A replay could accidentally use an installed or unrelated module with compatible behavior and still produce a passing JSON report; the result would not prove the frozen R8 candidate.
static_findings.required_control: The invoking acceptance record must capture the resolved video_paper_wiki_research.light_backup.__file__, SHA-256 of that exact file, the stopped R8 source root, and the exact R8 owner/candidate snapshot. Refuse to treat the harness result as R8 evidence if the module is outside that source root or its hash is absent/mismatched.

static_findings.summary: For malformed or mutated archives, the harness asserts verify_backup refusal but does not replay restore_backup refusal, destination absence, and input-byte preservation for each mutation.
static_findings.impact: The standalone harness cannot by itself establish the full R8 refusal invariant for every negative archive.
static_findings.required_control: Retain the R8 owner tests and any integrated replay covering restore refusal and unchanged bytes; describe this harness as a focused verifier/roundtrip control rather than the sole negative-path acceptance evidence.

static_findings.summary: --expect r7 intentionally accepts the pre-fix missing-UTF-8-marker loophole and expects Unicode refusal. That mode is a historical reproduction only.
static_findings.required_control: Use the default --expect fixed for R8 acceptance and retain --expect r7 only as immutable blocker evidence; never combine a passing r7 replay with final product acceptance.

non_findings: The harness does not broaden product scope: it uses the existing writer/API and only synthetic workspace members.
The local/central mutation helper edits both header classes and covers local-only, central-only and symmetric cases; the 13 negative cases are deterministic and narrow.
The selected Unicode names and external output are byte-checked after fixed-mode restore, while the ASCII control preserves the existing zero-flag behavior.
No source hash or active T2 implementation was inferred during this static review.
limitations: This is a static review of the fixed standalone harness; no harness execution or active T2 source inspection was performed.
This artifact does not accept the R8 implementation, exact source head, CI, installed wheel, real-paper trial, real Vault, external backup anchor or human gate.
The conditional decision applies only to a controlled fixed-mode replay with the provenance and companion owner-suite evidence above.
